info.title: Nexora Platform API
info.description: Canonical browser-facing contract for the Nexora platform API v1, including M2 identity, selected-tenant authorization and membership-directory, profile, CMS draft, workflow, publication, theme-reference, and typed SEO projections.

x-nexora-public.reason: Unauthenticated loopback bootstrap endpoint; it exposes platform contract metadata but no tenant or actor data.
Unauthenticated loopback validation probe; it accepts only a bounded echo payload and exposes no tenant or actor data.

get.summary: Read the authenticated actor's membership-derived access contexts

200.description: Active membership contexts for the authenticated actor

post.summary: Resolve one membership-derived tenant context from an organization selection candidate

200.description: Current active membership context for the requested organization

get.summary: Resolve the authenticated actor's tenant context from an explicit selection header

parameters.name: X-Nexora-Organization-Id
parameters.description: Organization selection candidate. It is never authority; the server derives authorization from the current active membership.

200.description: Current active membership context for the selected organization

get.summary: Read the server-derived permission matrix for one selected tenant context

parameters.name: X-Nexora-Organization-Id
parameters.description: Organization selection candidate. The server resolves a fresh active membership before deriving permissions.

200.description: The selected membership context and its server-derived permission strings

get.summary: List authoritative memberships within one selected tenant
get.description: The required organization header is only a selection candidate. The server resolves a fresh active acting membership and requires both user.manage and role.manage before returning the selected tenant's bounded membership rows.

200.description: Authoritative memberships for the selected tenant only, ordered by opaque membership identifier

patch.summary: Mutate one selected tenant membership with optimistic versioning
patch.description: The server derives the acting membership and permissions from current tenant authority. The target identifier and organization header are routing candidates only; no browser-provided role or status grants authority.

parameters.name: X-Nexora-Organization-Id
parameters.description: Organization selection candidate. The server resolves a fresh active acting membership and checks assignment authority.

200.description: The authoritative target membership after one permitted mutation

get.summary: Read the authenticated actor's allowlisted profile

put.summary: Update the authenticated actor's allowlisted profile with optimistic versioning

200.description: The updated profile with its new version

get.summary: List tenant-scoped page aggregates with stable cursor ordering

200.description: Tenant-scoped pages in deterministic cursor order

get.summary: Read one authorized tenant page aggregate

patch.summary: Update one draft with an expected version

delete.summary: Archive one page with optimistic concurrency

200.description: Page archived without deleting immutable history

post.summary: Apply one server-authorized workflow transition to an exact draft version
Publish or roll back an exact approved page version idempotently

200.description: Existing terminal receipt for an idempotent retry

201.description: New immutable published version and receipt

get.summary: Read one authorized constrained theme version

bearerAuth.description: Send a short-lived access token as Authorization: Bearer <token>. Authentication does not grant organization authorization.

TraceId.description: Opaque request correlation identifier. Callers may supply a safe value; the server replaces invalid values.

RequiredOrganizationHeader.name: X-Nexora-Organization-Id
RequiredOrganizationHeader.description: Organization selection candidate. The server resolves a current active membership and evaluates authorization before using it.

AuthenticationRequired.description: A valid bearer token is required.

PermissionDenied.description: The authenticated actor is not authorized for the requested operation.

InternalError.description: An unexpected error occurred. Internal implementation details are never returned.

ProfileNotFound.description: The authenticated actor does not yet have a profile.

VersionConflict.description: The request's optimistic version or protected ownership state conflicts with current authoritative state.

PublicationValidationFailed.description: A publish or rollback candidate failed immutable workflow, schema, theme or SEO validation.

ApiProblem.description: Stable, client-safe error envelope. It must not contain stack traces, provider responses, credentials, or request source.

details.description: Bounded field-level details safe for the caller.

propertyNames.x-nexora-normalization: Split camelCase and the '.', '_', '-' separators into lowercase segments before applying forbidden-key policy.

additionalProperties.description: A printable validation message or code. Sensitive diagnostics and credential-like values are forbidden.

OrganizationId.description: Opaque organization identifier. A caller may select it, but the server always derives access from a current active membership.

MembershipId.description: Opaque membership identifier returned by the server; it is not browser authority.

TenantRole.description: Frozen v1 tenant role. Permission evaluation remains server-side.

MembershipStatus.description: Authoritative lifecycle state returned by the server. Direct activation is not supported by the v1 mutation boundary.

MembershipMutationRequest.description: Exactly one role or status mutation with the target's current optimistic version. The server independently verifies current actor authority, target tenant, target version, and ownership invariants.

PageId.description: Opaque tenant-scoped CMS page identifier; it is never authority.

SiteId.description: Opaque site identifier scoped to the resolved organization.
